simple.meaning: חָח (châch) is a Hebrew word meaning “a ring for the nose (or lips).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חָח (H2397) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 35:22, with occurrences in Exodus, 2 Kings, Isaiah, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָח (H2397) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חָח (H2397) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חָח (châch) / H2397 is traced through Exodus 35:22, 2 Kings 19:28, Isaiah 37:29, Ezekiel 19:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a ring for the nose (or lips)
definitions.full: H2397. chach חַח noun masculine hook, ring, fetter ; — חַח absolute Exod 35:22 ; suffix חַחִי Isa 37:29 ; 2Kin 19:28 ; plural חַחִים Ezek 19:4 2 t. + 29:4 Qr (Kt erroneous חחיים , see below); — 1 hook, ring , in nose of captive בְּאַמֶּ֑ךָ חַחִי וְשַׂמְתִּי Isa 37:29 = 2Kin 19:28 (compare בַּחֹחִים 2Chr 33:11 , see חוֺחַ above); so of princes of Judah, under figure of young lions Ezek 19:4 , 9 (in 19:9 transp:, so that בחחים following הביא as 19:4 ; so Co); in jaws of crocodile (metaphor of Pharaoh), with נתן 29:4 , compare 38:4 (but ᵐ5 omits and sense opposes, compare Co and — dubious — Da). 2 hook, ring as ornament, perhaps nose-ring (others brooch , see VB), Exod 35:22 (P; || כּוּמָז טַבַּעַת, נֶזֶם, ). חוט (of following; Arabic , Aramaic , חַיֵּט sew ).
definitions.rootNote: once (Ezekiel 29:4) חָחִי ; from the same as 2336 ;
